entities.name: Krov
entities.description: Capital city of the kingdom of Kjeldor on Terisiare in Dominaria, later ravaged by plague and washed out to sea.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: The era in which Krov stood.

entities.name: Royal Academy of Magic
entities.description: Academy in Krov with thin, ornate spires.

entities.name: Kjeld
entities.description: Former capital of Kjeldor, where the royal family relocated during the plagues.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Spell whose casting led to the Thaw and hard times for Krov.

entities.name: Thaw
entities.description: A warming of the climate in which disease proliferated.

entities.name: Garza Zol
entities.description: Powerful vampire known as the "Plague Queen" who emerged inside Krov and ordered Heidar's assassination.

entities.name: Cult of Rimewind
entities.description: Cult that used Krov's libraries to locate Phyrexian war machines.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: Leader of the Cult of Rimewind who turned on Krov.

entities.name: Krovikans
entities.description: People of Krov who kept enemies' eyes and ears as war trophies.

entities.name: Shattered Sea
entities.description: The sea beneath which Krov's ruins now lie.

events.summary: The royal throne and family move to expanding Krov, which becomes the largest city in Kjeldor.
events.quote: the royal throne and family moved to the still-expanding Krov

events.summary: After the World Spell, the Thaw brings plagues to Krov and vampires and zombies infest the city.
events.quote: Krov was ravaged by a series of plagues that left its population suffering

events.summary: The royal family relocates to Kjeld and plague victims are quarantined inside Krov.
events.quote: quarantine the plague victims inside the walls of Krov

events.summary: Garza Zol orders the assassination of Heidar after he turns on Krov.
Plague-haunted Krov is washed out to the rising oceans.
events.quote: plague-haunted Krov was washed out to the rising oceans

relations.quote: Krov was the capital city of the kingdom of Kjeldor
